notes.title: Crown Gambit is Steam Deck Ready!
notes.content: [p]Whether you're plotting your next tactical or political move from the couch or on the go, the experience is smooth, sharp, and fully controller-friendly.[/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 Here’s what you can expect on Steam Deck:[/h3][list][*][p]✅ [b]Native controller support[/b][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Optimized for 16:10 aspect ratio[/b] — perfect fit for the Deck’s display.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Font scaling options[/b] — customize text size for comfort and readability.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Smooth performance[/b] — consistent [b]60 FPS[/b] for a fluid and responsive experience.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ve also received positive feedback from early players using the Deck, and we’re confident Crown Gambit is a strong fit for handheld play.[/p][p]To give you a glimpse of the experience, we’ve included a few [b]screenshots of Crown Gambit running on Steam Deck[/b] below. We’re proud of how well it performs on the device, and we hope it helps showcase what to expect.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241911/df9e1ee7935420fa3092017858de7299ad6afdf0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241911/bf2817e37cd67eabf8bba33513a922cde83e0ae1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241911/44c6f06a749133954f2e52a550d9203f4f48ac8e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241911/cb0b17c12e11a2c93763486985adbf22be7463cc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you’ve been playing on Steam Deck, we’d love to hear your thoughts or see your setups — feel free to drop a screenshot or mini review below![/p][p]Thank you for your support,[/p][p]— The Crown Gambit Team[/p]

notes.title: Patch #2 - July 7th 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hi Crown Gambit players! Thank you again for all the feedback you provided! [/p][p][/p][p][b]What was fixed: [/b][/p][list][*][p]Missing intro combat cutscene for Karmine and Havrok in chapters 15/16/17[/p][/*][*][p]Some dialogue incoherences[/p][/*][*][p]Missing portraits in some dialogues[/p][/*][*][p]Spelling errors[/p][/*][*][p]Cropped lines in decision phases[/p][/*][*][p]Visual glitch with Pure Acid[/p][/*][*][p]Missing trigger for Incorruptible achievement [/p][/*][*][p]Not working disable screenshake setting[/p][/*][*][p]Missing keyword highlight in Hunan passive[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]What was added: [/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]A new button to skip dialogues faster[/p][/*][*][p]Improved VFX performances (which should hopefully minimize crashes)[/p][/*][*][p]New accessibilty feature: disable camera panning when screenshake is disabled[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory access during level up is now available[/p][/*][*][p]Ancestral Grace feature after chapter 2 is forced. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We hope this new patch improves your experience and, as always, will read your feedback thoroughly! 

The Crown Gambit team. [/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Crown Gambit is available now!
notes.content:
[p]The kingdom of Meodred awaits: [b]Crown Gambit is available now on Steam! [/b] 

In this mysterious dark-fantasy universe inspired by Celtic and Breton folklore and drawn by French artist [b]Gobert[/b], use the skills of three intrepid paladins to overcome political turmoil.

[b]Aliza, the blood-bending swashbuckler, Hael, the mace-wielding cleric, and Rollo, the anchor-waving tanker[/b] will have to make dreadful choices during their journey as they pledge allegiance to one of the pretenders to the throne.[/p][p]
Crown Gambit mixes [b]epic, board-shattering card battles[/b] and deck-building with strong narrative, storytelling and multiple endings.

Interact with a wide cast of fascinating characters and make [b]difficult decisions[/b] to reveal all their secrets now! [/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="060dTm7i6mA;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Crown Gambit is coming to Steam June 18th 2025!
notes.content:
We are excited to share the news:  Crown Gambit will be released on PC and Mac this Summer on June 18th 2025. You've never been so close to exploring the kingdom of Meodred and getting the answers to your questions: 

- Who killed the king? 
- Which heir will succeed to the throne?
- What secrets does Meodred hold? 

While we wait to discover the mysteries of Crown Gambit's story, check out our trailer!

[previewyoutube=tYMW9DfpgvI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Crown Gambit is coming to PC Summer 2025! ⚔️
notes.content:
As announced during Future Games Show Spring, Crown Gambit gets a release period: Summer 2025! 

Can't wait for release? You can still enjoy the demo until March 31st and wishlist the game to support Crown Gambit! 

[previewyoutube=7fOeKNm68OA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]DEMO FEATURES
[/b]
[list]
[*] Revised tutorial phase, 
[*] New game intro, 
[*] New interface and travel phases 
[*] Reworked balancing for Ancestral Grace gameplay mechanics and combat systems  
[*] New choices and dialogues
[/list]

Explore the first two chapters of Crown Gambit entirely in an updated demo. 
The kingdom of Meodred's tenuous balance of power is being shaken to its core after the king's assassination and mysterious forces seem to be pulling strings from the dark. 
Experience the beginning of our three heroes' journey, make the right choices to guide their path, find the assassin, and take the young Prince to safety in the capital! 
Encounter your first boss battle and discover the Ancestral Grace mechanic: channel board-shattering strength through ancient relics to defeat your enemies. Beware not to lose your soul though…

Hello everyone !

We feel exhilarated, grateful, proud and humble all at the same time. Your faithful support means so much to us. 💓
